title: ICC to hold final status conference in Duterte case before trial proper

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III will hold its final status conference in the case against former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte before his trial proper begins on Nov. 30, to discuss key procedural preparations. The session will run from 10 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. (5 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. Philippine time), with an additional session from noon to 1:30 p.m. (7 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. Philippine time). In line with transparency protocols, the broadcast of the Duterte proceedings will be delayed by 30 minutes on the ICC’s official website and social media accounts. READ: Duterte victims’ […]...
